title: Intermountain West
summary: County-line guess for the Utah and Idaho trees. Regional scopes tile each state. City scopes cover the named communities. The panhandle names come from the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Boise is the Idaho scope that also carries pnw.

cards.title: Idaho
cards.extraHeading: Panhandle and Palouse, from the Pacific Northwest hierarchy

imw.name: Intermountain West
imw.note: Backbone scope above both state tags. Drawn as the two states together.

ut.name: Utah
ut.note: State scope. The five regional scopes below tile Utah.

wf.name: Wasatch Front
wf.note: The urban corridor from Ogden through Utah County, plus Tooele County on the west desert. Ogden, Salt Lake, and Utah County have their own city scopes.

ogd.name: Ogden, Layton, Bountiful, Plain City
ogd.note: Weber and Davis counties: Ogden, Plain City, Layton, and Bountiful.

slc.name: Salt Lake City, Draper, West Jordan
slc.note: Salt Lake County, including Salt Lake City, West Jordan, and Draper.

utc.name: Lehi, Provo, Santaquin
utc.note: Utah County, from Lehi through Provo to Santaquin.

wb.name: Wasatch Back: Park City, Heber, Vernal
wb.note: Summit and Wasatch counties hold Park City and Heber. Duchesne, Uintah, and Daggett carry that scope across the Uinta Basin to Vernal. Morgan sits east of Ogden, behind the Wasatch.

n-ut.name: Brigham City, Logan, Tremonton
n-ut.note: Box Elder and Cache counties hold Brigham City, Tremonton, and Logan. Rich County stays on n-ut as the rest of the northern tier.

c-ut.name: Nephi, Moab, Beaver, Richfield
c-ut.note: Juab, Sevier, Beaver, and Grand counties match the named towns. The counties between them, including Millard, Sanpete, Carbon, Emery, and San Juan, stay on c-ut.

s-ut.name: Southern Utah
s-ut.note: Southern Utah splits into Cedar City and St. George. Garfield and Kane counties are the eastern portion of those two scopes.

ced.name: Cedar City
ced.note: Iron County holds Cedar City. Garfield County (Panguitch and Bryce) is grouped here as the closest southern scope.

stg.name: St. George
stg.note: Washington County holds St. George. Kane County (Kanab) is grouped with it along the Arizona line.

pnw-boi.name: Pacific Northwest — Boise only
pnw-boi.note: In the Intermountain tree, Boise is the Idaho scope that also carries pnw.

id.name: Idaho
id.note: State scope. Southwest, southern, and eastern Idaho follow the Intermountain tree. The panhandle follows the Pacific Northwest hierarchy.

sw-id.name: Southwest Idaho
sw-id.note: Southwest Idaho. Ada and Canyon counties are the Boise metro; Emmett, Payette, Weiser, McCall, Mountain Home, and the Owyhee desert stay on sw-id.

boi.name: Boise, Meridian, Nampa, Caldwell
boi.note: Ada and Canyon counties: Boise, Meridian, Nampa, and Caldwell. This is the scope that also carries pnw.

s-id.name: Southern Idaho
s-id.note: South-central Idaho: the Wood River valley and the Magic Valley.

twf.name: Twin Falls, Gooding, Jerome, Mini-Cassia, Magic Valley
twf.note: Magic Valley counties: Twin Falls, Gooding, Jerome, Lincoln, Minidoka, and Cassia, plus Camas County on the north edge.

sun.name: Sun Valley, Blaine County
sun.note: Blaine County: Sun Valley, Ketchum, and Hailey.

e-id.name: Eastern Idaho
e-id.note: Eastern Idaho. The Snake River cities have their own scopes. Butte, Clark, Custer, and Lemhi counties stay on e-id.

pih.name: Pocatello, Chubbuck, Malad, Soda Springs
pih.note: Bannock, Oneida, and Caribou counties match Pocatello, Malad, and Soda Springs. Power, Franklin, and Bear Lake stay with them as the rest of the southeast corner.

ida.name: Idaho Falls, Blackfoot
ida.note: Bonneville and Bingham counties hold Idaho Falls and Blackfoot. Jefferson County (Rigby) stays with Idaho Falls.

mad.name: Rexburg
mad.note: Madison County holds Rexburg. Fremont and Teton counties (St. Anthony and Driggs) stay up-valley on mad.

n-id.name: Northern Idaho (Moscow, Lewiston, Clearwater)
n-id.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. The Palouse and Clearwater are the local scope; Idaho County stays on n-id.

lws.name: Lewiston / Moscow / Clearwater
lws.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Latah, Nez Perce, Lewis, and Clearwater counties.

uofi.name: University of Idaho, Moscow campus
uofi.note: Campus-only scope from the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Drawn as the Moscow campus, inside lws.

cda.name: Coeur d'Alene / N. Idaho panhandle
cda.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Boundary, Bonner, Kootenai, Benewah, and Shoshone counties: Sandpoint, Coeur d'Alene, and the Silver Valley.
